test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given pie-diagram shows the expenditure incurred on the preparation of a book by a publisher, under various heads. Study the pie-diagram and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e08dd79516d21bfcbc0b936c928f5b81f9b192aea2d50f0e64a55b8ab0954485.png] 

Various Expenditures (in percentage) incurred in Publishing a Book

What is the angle of the pie-diagram showing the expenditure incurred on paying royalty?
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure on royalty = 15%

**Formula used:**

Angle for a section of the pie chart = frac{{Percentage}}{100} times 360

**Calculations:**

⇒ Angle for royalty = (15)/(100) times 360

⇒ Angle for royalty = 0.15 × 360 = 54°

**∴ The angle of the pie-diagram showing the expenditure incurred on paying royalty is 54°.**
